ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Renamed Comsvcs DLL Loaded By Rundll32
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects rundll32 loading a renamed comsvcs.dll to dump process memory Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=eed93054cb555f3de70eaa9787f32ebb.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=5e0dbdec1fce52daae251a110b4f309d.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=eadbccbb324829acb5f2bbe87e5549a8.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=407ca0f7b523319d758a40d7c0193699.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=281d618f4e6271e527e6386ea6f748de.*"))) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\comsvcs\\\.dll$"))
